memo.summary: Tumble Aggregates quarries stone and recycles construction material in the south of England; pricing has held up despite flat volumes.
memo.what_it_does: Quarries stone and recycles construction material across the south of England.

products.name: Primary aggregates
products.what: crushed stone for concrete and roadbase

memo.how_it_earns: Volume-priced stone plus a growing recycled stream whose margin is structurally higher.
bear: Planning permission for new pits is slow and uncertain.
memo.bear_hardest: A construction downturn hits volumes harder than price, and the recycled-margin story takes years to show.
gaps: Recycled vs primary split is estimated from commentary.

tv.summary: Tumble Aggregates quarries stone and recycles construction material in the south of England; pricing has held up despite flat volumes.
tv.variant_view: Recycled aggregate margins are structurally higher than primary stone and the mix shift is not yet visible in reported margins.
tv.catalysts: Full-year results in March; new depot openings.
tv.risks: Construction volumes are cyclical and UK-centred.
tv.invalidation: Recycled-aggregate margin fails to widen through 2027.
tv.exit_conditions: Thesis invalidated, or the position reaches its target weight through price alone.
tv.reason_for_change: Tightened the invalidation condition after the interim update.
